name: temporal-claims-demo
description: Insurance claim processing demo built on Temporal (TypeScript SDK), NestJS and React

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @claims/worker && npm run build -w @claims/api && npm run build -w @claims/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @claims/worker && npm run test -w @claims/api
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w @claims/worker && npm run test -w @claims/api
scripts.temporal: temporal server start-dev --ip 0.0.0.0 --port 7233 --ui-port 8233 --db-filename .temporal/claims-demo.db --search-attribute ClaimStatus=Keyword --search-attribute ClaimType=Keyword --search-attribute Policyholder=Keyword --search-attribute ClaimAmount=Double --search-attribute FraudScore=Double
